body:
Explicit policies can be discarded by VM option binding or allowed to fail open. This replacement reconciles #750 at `1522f14aa1994d03af72441f2554718c9cfc11cb` against refreshed main `a3ae3b16b5afebff4a7ba3c0d2cffe8a69c11b1d`. It binds the requested policy and rejects open/read/parse failures before execution using existing Axion semantics. Restoring the shared binding also requires validation on existing debugger/inspector paths. No-policy defaults and JSON diagnostics are preserved.

Original #750 and its branch remain unchanged. This candidate imports its bounded policy correction rather than its obsolete #747 stack. The sole patch-context conflict was CMake registration; #782's repro working directory, Windows entry/argument conversion, process capture, cleanup, arithmetic and golden hash remain unchanged. No policy-model expansion or scientific-gate advancement.

Five implementation/test files are separate from 47 audit/evidence files (2,417,527 bytes). Code commit: `4a93e0392b5deec5fed22dd95849c91871465344`; following evidence commit changes documentation only. [Pinned audit packet](https://github.com/t81dev/t81-foundation/blob/15b6b2b63fe056d68f959d658a351eba603ce6ea/docs/records/audits/2026-11-14-pr750-main-candidate/README.md) retains exact commands, source/binary hashes, all stdout/stderr/statuses, artifact comparisons, original patch, #782 comparisons, and failed intermediate attempts.

Fresh local macOS ARM64, AppleClang 21, C++23 Release/`-DNDEBUG`, strict deterministic float ON:

- Final identical expanded harness: unfixed main **249 processes / 670 failed checks**; candidate **249 / zero**.
- Byte-identical original #750 harness: unfixed main **73 / 138 failed checks**; candidate **73 / zero**.
- Registered policy, repro-hash and process-capture CTests: **3/3 passed**.
- Missing, malformed, empty, overflow, trailing-invalid, directory, zero-budget and valid policies; three option positions; VM run/trace, code source/bytecode and affected VM inspector/debug paths. Denied probes create no new traces, preserve pre-existing output and produce no program sentinel output. Intentional JSON error responses are checked as diagnostics.

Limits: native Linux/Windows MSVC/clang-cl and current-head hosted CI pending; no full-suite or sanitizer claim. Mid-read I/O failures are checked in source but not deterministically injected. Artifact checks cover fixture/child-temp trees, not all host setup/constructor effects. Directory behavior is platform-dependent. REPL and other command families are outside this bounded scope. Raw CTest/patch whitespace is retained byte-for-byte; source whitespace checks pass, packet-wide checks flag raw evidence.

Prepared and tested by Codex within the shared maintenance effort that contributed to the earlier work; this is not independent review. Draft for maintainer review; no merge or policy activation.
title: fix(cli): reconcile explicit execution policies on current main
